name: HOL Guard
summary: Local-first security tool for AI coding agents: checks shell commands, secret access, MCP changes and plugin installs before they run, with a free local tier and paid cloud plans.
best_for: developers and small teams who run coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor on their own machines and want risky actions paused before they run
skip_if: you do not use coding agents, you need a cloud MCP gateway or full prompt-injection defence, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: Coverage is specific to each supported tool and event, and the vendor says it does not stop prompt injection as a whole. The paid plans add cloud history rather than stronger local checks. The trial length differs between pages. We have not installed it, so block quality and false alarms are unknown to us.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-18 on hol.org/guard/pricing, US dollars, monthly view; annual billing is shown as 2 months free) Free: $0 forever, local protection, no account or card. Solo: $4.99 a month, 2 cloud devices, 30 days retention, 1 GB. Pro: $15 a month, 5 devices, 180 days, 5 GB, real-time alerts. Team: $30 per seat a month, up to 25 devices, 365 days. Enterprise: contact sales. We have not paid for a plan.

compare_with.name: Mycroft
compare_with.why: Mycroft is a company-wide security and compliance platform with a managed service, while HOL Guard is a local tool that watches what coding agents try to run. They solve different problems, so compare scope before cost.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested the HOL Guard web dashboard in the Pro trial that we started. Guard only works after a local install by script, so without a machine every screen stayed empty. A plain-language policy rule was turned into a draft block rule at once. Cancelling the renewal took two clicks with no offer. Account and start: we created the account and started the trial; the workspace runs a Pro trial, Billed monthly, Trial ends Nov 22, Pro $15 / mo. Our AI assistant ran the test in our browser on 19 November 2026 from about 16:05 to 16:35 CET. The interface was in English; only one date followed the browser locale and is covered in the screenshots. A hard limit for this test: nothing was installed on the laptop, so only the web account and dashboard were tested. Usage at the start: PROTECTED DEVICES 0 / 5, AUTOMATION CREDITS 500 / 2,500 Running low, PROTECTED ACTIONS 0 No blocks. Invoices: No invoices. Settings show Data retention 180 days and Machine limit Up to 5 machines. Core action, the web parts: Home said Nothing needs you and pointed to Install Guard on your first machine. Add a machine shows a curl install script for macOS and Linux and a PowerShell command for Windows, then hol-guard connect; without a machine the dashboard, Evidence, Review and AI Firewall stay empty. Policy: Describe a rule lets you write a rule in plain words. The example Block the left-pad npm package for 30 days was sent at once and gave 1 rule to check: Block left-pad in every AI tool, until 2026-12-19, with the warning This blocks every version of left-pad, since rules match package names, not versions. After Add 1 rule the policy read Draft, saved, Not published. It was not published. Ask Guard answered the question what Guard checks before an AI coding agent runs a command: the tool, the exact command, package requests and publisher, file reads, MCP servers, new network domains and changed artifacts, each ending as allow, warn, review or block with a receipt. It said the draft policy had zero rules while it already had 1, so the assistant ran behind. The free risk check, which needs no install, asked 3 of its 7 questions and then offered a report by e-mail; Get my report failed twice with Something went wrong. Please try again. Accounts your AI can use: Accounts are not available on this Guard Cloud yet. Checkout: the trial was started by us before the session and no checkout was seen. The web interface shows no card number and no separate charge date, only the period end. Cancelling, done the same day: Billing, Subscriptions, Cancel renewal next to Guard Cloud Pro. One inline step: This stops the next renewal. Your current term ends 22 nov 2026, with Confirm cancellation and Keep subscription. No reason form, no retention offer and no password. After a reload: Renewal canceled. Ends 22 nov 2026. Pro stays usable until the trial ends. Not tested: anything that needs a machine (installing Guard, hol-guard connect, real blocks, Evidence records, the AI Firewall for npm and pip, reviewing paused actions), team workspaces, publishing the policy and the risk check report. Clean up: one saved draft policy with 1 rule (not published) and one Ask Guard chat stay; the renewal is cancelled. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Without a local install nothing can be tested beyond the policy draft and Ask Guard. Ask Guard described the draft as having zero rules after a rule had been added. The free risk check failed at Get my report.

friction.export_route: No export or reimport was performed; no file was downloaded or examined. The two categorised kit records were not entered; the objects tested were not kit records.
friction.cancellation: Cancelling takes two clicks in the web dashboard: Cancel renewal, then Confirm cancellation, with no reason, offer or password. Pro stays active until the trial ends.
